# netbox_custom_field_choice_sets (Data Source)

Lists custom_field_choice_set objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_custom_field_choice_sets" "test" {
  limit = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Supported names: id, id__empty, id__gt, id__gte, id__lt, id__lte, id__n, owner_id, owner_id__n. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.
- `name_regex` (String) Go regular expression the name must match. Applied after the API query, which then fetches every object matching the filters; limit applies to the matches.

### Read-Only

- `custom_field_choice_sets` (Attributes List) The matching custom_field_choice_sets. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_field_choice_sets))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the query filter (the API list parameter).
- `value` (String) Value to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--custom_field_choice_sets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_field_choice_sets`

Read-Only:

- `base_choices` (String) Predefined set of choices to start from. One of: IATA, ISO_3166, UN_LOCODE.
- `choices_count` (Number)
- `created` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `extra_choices` (Attributes List) Additional choices as value/label pairs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_field_choice_sets--extra_choices))
- `id` (Number) NetBox id of the choice set.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `order_alphabetically` (Boolean) Sort choices alphabetically instead of by definition order.
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `url` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--custom_field_choice_sets--extra_choices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_field_choice_sets.extra_choices`

Read-Only:

- `label` (String)
- `value` (String)
